name: Matara
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 population-weighted settlement point in latitude/longitude order; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Sri Lanka Survey Department is the evidenced national cadastral/Land Information System custodian, and the Registrar General's Department lists Matara among its land-registry locations. No Matara-local public parcel-vector endpoint was independently verified.
technicalBlocker: The current public NSDI Parcel Fabrics service was inspected, but its advertised extent begins north of the unchanged Matara WUP point and the bounded query returned zero features. The Survey Department SLCadastre/LIS pages were blocked by HTTP 406 in this environment. No geometry or native parcel ID was qualified for retention.
scopeLimits: A zero bounded query and advertised service extent miss are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. No full parcel polygons were retained. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or other unsafe identity fields were requested or retained.

fieldMapping.mappingNote: Candidate field names came from official layer metadata only; no feature properties were retained. No internal synthetic row number was used.

unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or ownership fields were requested as selected output or retained. The layer metadata showed such fields in one unrelated layer, but they were not queried.
limits: The exact WUP point is preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The NSDI Parcel Fabrics advertised extent excludes the exact Matara point; the empty bounded response cannot establish parcel absence in Matara or Sri Lanka.
SLCadastre and the Survey Department KML page were not accessible anonymously in this environment because their hosts returned HTTP 406; no certificate exception or anti-bot bypass was attempted.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
uncertainty: Official national cadastral custody and Matara land-registry coverage are evidenced, but a public Matara parcel geometry response and stable native identity were not verified during this attempt.
